welcome.subheadline: Build biomass, beat winter, protect your yield
welcome.introRest: to complement fertilisation by giving Oilseed Rape an additional source of biologically fixed nitrogen from the air. This drives robust biomass, reliable overwintering and dependable yields, making the most of the crop’s critical establishment phase.
welcome.visualLabel: Campaign key visual: Bio Engineers on the autumn construction site

howItWorks.title: How VIXERAN® works
howItWorks.bodyRest: to complement fertilisation. The bacteria colonise the plant and fix atmospheric nitrogen, providing an additional source of biologically fixed nitrogen to support crop development during establishment.
howItWorks.visualLabel: Bio Engineers piping nitrogen through a crop leaf

robust.title: Robust
robust.body: VIXERAN® contain a particularly robust bacterium in that it can withstand external stress conditions, making it particularly suitable for foliar applications

nitrogenUptake.title: How VIXERAN® enhances crop nitrogen uptake
nitrogenUptake.body: The video demonstrates how the nitrogen-fixing bacteria in VIXERAN® penetrate the plant's leaves, roots, and root zone, fixing freely available nitrogen from the air and converting it into ammonium nitrogen that can be absorbed by the crop. In a dormant state, the bacteria form cysts that protect them against unfavourable factors such as cold. However, when the bacteria come into contact with moisture and warmth, they are activated. The nitrogen that VIXERAN® fixes for the plant is not leached or evaporated.

foundations.title: Why autumn establishment matters
foundations.lead: The first weeks after emergence define future performance.

roots.title: Robust establishment
roots.body: Strong roots and early biomass build the foundation for the crop ahead.
roots.back: A vigorous root system improves water and nutrient uptake through the season.

biomass.title: Yield stability
biomass.body: A well-established crop has more resources to sustain growth through the season.
biomass.back: More autumn biomass means more resources to carry into spring.

winter.title: More resilience for winter
winter.body: Stronger, well-established crops are better prepared to face winter conditions.
winter.back: Better-prepared crops come through winter with greater resilience.

spring.title: More potential in spring
spring.body: What the crop builds in autumn sets the stage for spring growth.
spring.back: Solid autumn foundations set up stronger yield potential.

bioEngineers.title: How VIXERAN® Works
bioEngineers.body1: VIXERAN® contains Azotobacter salinestris, a naturally occurring endophytic bacterium that colonises the plant from within.
bioEngineers.body2: It captures atmospheric nitrogen and converts it into ammonium, providing an additional source of nitrogen when the crop needs it most.
